description: Nostr client with Monero tips. No Lightning, no custodian, no wallet inside. monostr is a Nostr client for Android with tips in Monero. Nostr, the way you know it • Feed of the people you follow, threads, profiles with Posts and Replies tabs • Like, repost, quote, reply; mentions, hashtags and links you can tap • Pictures in notes and your own uploads (Blossom), sensitive content blurred • Private messages (NIP-17), private bookmarks and mutes (NIP-51) • Search for people and notes (NIP-50), notifications for likes, reposts, replies and tips • Your relay list (NIP-65); write relays of an author are added while their profile is open • Sign in with Amber (NIP-55) or a key; light and dark theme, 8 languages Tips in Monero • Tip a note or a profile from your own wallet app (Unstoppable, monfluo, Cake …) through a monero: link • monostr holds no wallet and no spend key • To receive tips you register your address and private view key with a watcher (watcher.monostr.com by default, or your own). The watcher sees your incoming payments and publishes signed tip receipts on Nostr, so everybody sees the tip on the note • Anonymous tips are possible Open monostr is free software (AGPL-3.0-or-later). Notes, likes and reposts say “via monostr” (off by default, can be switched on). Follower numbers can come from Primal's index, a proprietary service; that is off by default and can be switched on too. monostr is in beta.
